ordered_steps.name: validate_envelope
ordered_steps.rule: Reject unknown fields, malformed types/encodings, operation-name mismatch, parameters_digest mismatch, or envelope_digest mismatch.

ordered_steps.name: authenticate_channel
ordered_steps.rule: Derive actor/channel from the live authenticated broker session and require exact equality with the envelope; caller declarations are ignored.

ordered_steps.name: transition_lookup
ordered_steps.rule: Linearizably query the canonical transition index by transition_id before generation comparison. Exact equality of the complete envelope returns the stored result/receipt without effects. Any unequal field returns state_conflict and no receipt coordinates.

ordered_steps.name: generation_compare
ordered_steps.rule: For an unseen transition_id require expected_generation equal the authoritative generation.

ordered_steps.name: evaluate_guards
ordered_steps.rule: Require operation from_phase equal current phase or transition_invalid; evaluate every typed table guard and every applicable pre-state conditional invariant without effects; return only the highest-precedence declared safe failure.

ordered_steps.name: atomic_commit
ordered_steps.rule: Atomically append one canonical delta event, update the transition index, apply all operation effects/artifacts, require every post-state conditional invariant, and set new_generation=expected_generation+1. Any postcondition failure aborts the whole transaction. No operation table repeats this implicit generation effect.

ordered_steps.name: receipt_after_commit
ordered_steps.rule: Persist the generic operation receipt in the same transaction; delivery may be retried by exact envelope lookup but commit may not be re-executed.

transition_index.value: complete envelope digest plus committed result and receipt
transition_index.rollback: part of the same transaction as the journal event; derived indexes must be rebuildable from the canonical journal

global_store_machine.rule: One DSPx transaction validates the closed command envelope, subject, independent global config, and both fixed-depth claim updates; inserts journal->subject and stable-attempt->journal into persistent SMT node stores; creates exactly one immutable sealed record and initial execution journal; then advances both roots, sequence, and generation. The transaction is all-or-nothing. Update proofs are command-local CAS inputs. Later descriptor reads generate renewable current membership witnesses outside the immutable record. Hard maximum is 16384; max+1 is resource_exhausted before effects.

persistent_smt_store.atomicity: Both maps, all referenced nodes, both new roots, the sealed record, initial execution journal event, transition replay index, and global generation commit in one local transaction.
persistent_smt_store.retention: Every node reachable from a committed current root remains available for membership generation; unreachable uncommitted nodes are discarded.
persistent_smt_store.witness_generation: A descriptor-anchored read of one committed generation can generate exactly 256 siblings for any present digest key without scanning journal count.

predicate_language.guard_failure: Every guard declares one closed safe failure. The transaction protocol pre-validates malformed inputs as invalid_input, collects all false guards without effects, and returns only the highest-precedence declared kind.
predicate_language.rule: First execute/verify the canonical global allocate-and-seal transaction. Then validate the broker-created sealed record and project immutable initial fields only through initial_state_projection. Every committed execution operation authenticates actor/request, checks stored pins, exact framed identifier derivations, all clocks and resource guards, transition-ID replay, and expected_generation; applies effects atomically; increments generation once; canonicalizes sets. External guards come only from named broker/verifier mechanisms.
predicate_language.contract_predicate_rule: Every predicate under a closed contract, sealed-subject join, sealed-record contract, or initial_state_binding uses exactly one listed operator with typed paths. Unknown operators, fields, path roots, operand types, malformed encodings, untrusted descriptor routes, or partial reads are invalid_input. descriptor_parse_eq performs the exact local_global_head_contract derivation and equality check; lte/gte/lt use integer or UTC ordering; raw_sha256_eq hashes decoded canonical raw bytes; ed25519_verify uses the declared fixed signature preimage; valid_smt_membership uses sparse_merkle_contract.membership_verification. Every known-false contract predicate declares failure; validators collect all failures and return only the highest-precedence safe kind. eq_recomputed is legal only for a contract named in digest_domains and excludes exactly that registry member.

sparse_merkle_contract.cost: exactly 256 sibling hashes per pre root and 256 per post root for each map; input is fixed at 16,384 sibling bytes across both maps plus bounded framing
sparse_merkle_contract.key: raw 32 bytes decoded from lowercase sha256 digest key; bits consumed most-significant first

field_types.siblings_base64: array of exactly 256 canonical base64 values, each exactly 32 bytes

verification.sibling_order: siblings_base64[0] is the root-level sibling for key bit 255; siblings_base64[255] is the leaf-level sibling for key bit 0
verification.algorithm: Using the same sibling_index 255 down to 0 and bit_index = 255 - sibling_index mapping, recompute the pre root from empty_leaf_hash and post root from leaf_hash(raw_key_32, raw_value_32); both roots must equal the proof.

sparse_merkle_contract.value: raw 32 bytes decoded from lowercase sha256 digest value

membership_verification.input: map name, raw digest key/value, selected descriptor-derived current root, and exactly 256 canonical raw-32 siblings
membership_verification.sibling_order: siblings_base64[0] is the root-level sibling for key bit 255; siblings_base64[255] is the leaf-level sibling for key bit 0
membership_verification.algorithm: Start with leaf_hash(raw_key_32, raw_value_32). For sibling_index from 255 down to 0, set bit_index = 255 - sibling_index and combine current with siblings_base64[sibling_index] as left/right according to key bit bit_index. The final canonical digest must equal the selected root.

read_spool_protocol.single_read: Only the worker that commits admitted->claimed may perform one protected-store read. Claimed is never retried after crash; owner cleanup cancels it. Population persists payload digest/immutable spool before delivery.
read_spool_protocol.delivery: Retries read the same immutable populated spool under read_id. Transport duplication is possible but another protected-store read is not.
read_spool_protocol.close: readable_spool_count is zero and in-flight IDs are empty; no readable capability remains.

spawn_supervisor_protocol.prepare: Before start_commit, DSPx creates an empty unique OS containment selected by spawn_containment_digest; failure leaves no process and no committed start.
spawn_supervisor_protocol.commit: start_commit consumes the reservation, records one spawn_intent_digest and the containment, and marks the claim unclaimed.
spawn_supervisor_protocol.claim: claim_spawn_intent is the sole CAS from unclaimed to claimed. Exactly one persistent supervisor worker may issue exactly one spawn syscall into that containment. A claimed intent is never retried after worker/supervisor crash.
spawn_supervisor_protocol.recover: Recovery inspects the containment using PID-reuse-resistant handles. It records the one observed process or terminates everything in the containment and proves it empty. Ambiguity has no close/verdict transition.
spawn_supervisor_protocol.close: Both started and not-started closure require the containment empty.
